knowledge_point.title: Finding the Number of Pivot Columns of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $D,$ given by

$$
D=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 4 & 0\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we need to convert $D$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 4 & 0\end{bmatrix} \\  & \quad {R}_{4} :={R}_{4}+(2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $D$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
